title: Several Apple products: attackers can get in without a password
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed, but the vulnerability is more than a year old and we see no ransomware use, public attack tools, internet-facing product, critical severity or high prediction score. Check whether it applies to you.

category.label: Computers, phones and browsers
category.why: It runs on staff computers, phones or browsers.
category.doThis: Install the latest updates on every device, and turn on automatic updates.

summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. CISA set Nov 18, 2026 as the deadline for US federal agencies. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
